### Directed vs. Undirected

A directed graph means an edge specifies the direction that you must follow to traverse from one node from another.
In the graph below, you can move from node 0 to node 1, but you can't directly go from node 1 to node 0.

An undirected graph means you can move in either direction between nodes as long as the edge exists.
In the graph below, you can directly and freely  move between node 0 and node 1 in either direction.
